title.en: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office Located in the Municipality of Rodriguez (Montalban), Province of Rizal, Into a District Office to Be Known as the LTO Montalban District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office Located in the Municipality of Rodriguez (Montalban), Province of Rizal, Into a District Office to Be Known as the LTO Montalban District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực LTO Montalban tại Đô thị Rodriguez (Montalban), Tỉnh Rizal, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขต LTO Montalban ในเทศบาล Rodriguez (Montalban) จังหวัด Rizal และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik LTO Montalban di Kotamadya Rodriguez (Montalban), Provinsi Rizal, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah LTO Montalban di Perbandaran Rodriguez (Montalban), Wilayah Rizal, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The extension office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Rodriguez (Montalban), Province of Rizal, is hereby converted into a district office to be known as the LTO Montalban District Office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO Montalban District Office. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
